name: @open-games/shared
description: Shared, pure/testable cross-game utilities for the open-games monorepo: responsive canvas scaling, DPR/backbuffer clamping, a Phaser scale-config builder, touch-input mapping, and a tiny i18n scaffold. Consumed as TypeScript source by each game's Vite build (no dist emitted, no build script) so the deploy assemble step is unaffected.
